headline: MD and enhanced sampling resolve unbinding pathways and allosteric coupling
label: Molecular Dynamics Sampling And Validation
summary: Weighted ensemble, metadynamics, and ML-derived collective variables are now applied alongside MD to probe unbinding and allosteric switches in drug and…
synthesis: The dominant thread is the use of molecular dynamics and enhanced sampling to link binding and conformational events to kinetic and allosteric behavior. Weighted ensemble simulations with weakened protein-protein interactions probe DCAF15-RBM39 unbinding under molecular glues E7820 and Indisulam analogs, while metadynamics with conventional MD relates DLG motif flipping and αC helix rotation to reshaping of the RIPK1 ATP pocket and hinge allostery. ML-derived collective variables map p53 L1 loop transitions between DNA-binding and recessed states, and MD with ML clustering identifies TCR-pMHC contacts modulating allosteric dynamics. The IL1R1 study, using MD and CABS-flex, reports that antagonists increase D3 domain flexibility at the co-receptor interface, blocking co-receptor recruitment. Across these items, the emphasis falls on unbinding pathways and allosteric coupling, though systems and methods vary considerably.
